rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for products, practices, or policies that are not harmful to the environment.

example.english: This laundry detergent is quite ecological and won't pollute the river.
example.traditional: 呢款洗衣液幾環保，唔會污染條河。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sai2 ji1 jik6 gei2 waan4 bou2 m4 wui5 wu1 jim5 tiu4 ho4

rows.jyutping: sang1 taai3 fong1 min6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this before a noun when referring specifically to ecology and the relationships between organisms and their environment.

example.english: I want to read more ecological books.
example.traditional: 我想睇多啲生態方面嘅書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tai2 do1 di1 sang1 taai3 fong1 min6 ge3 syu1
